template.constraints: Use natural language. Testdata provides visa-related details.
manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user

variants.name: UK visa happy flow
variants.goal: Successfully request a UK visa support letter from HR

phases.description: State UK visa letter request intent
phases.completionCriteria: Bot has acknowledged the UK visa letter intent and shown employee details or asked for travel info

phases.description: Provide travel date/purpose and confirm submission
phases.completionCriteria: Bot has confirmed the UK visa letter request has been raised

variants.name: UK visa edge case flow
variants.goal: Test UK visa letter request with edge-case travel details

phases.description: State UK visa letter intent with near-future travel date
phases.completionCriteria: Bot has accepted or flagged the travel date and advanced the flow

phases.description: Complete the request and get confirmation
phases.completionCriteria: Bot confirms the UK visa letter request or explains any restriction

variants.name: UK visa edgecase 1 flow
variants.goal: Test bot behaviour when travel date is very soon or in the past for UK visa letter

phases.description: Request UK visa letter with an edge-case travel date
phases.completionCriteria: Bot either processes the request or explains the date restriction
